capabilities: Sanitize illegal filename characters in new wikilinks
Prevent the file name error popup when linking
Preserve aliases, headings, markdown tables and code blocks while sanitizing
disambiguation: Not a note title validator or renamer; it only rewrites illegal characters in wikilink text at the moment a link is created.
extras: Zero-configuration: no settings, ribbons or commands; it runs silently once enabled. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Typing wikilinks with characters like : ? * or / triggers a 'File name cannot contain...' error and breaks link creation.
summary: Sanitizer that automatically replaces illegal Windows filename characters inside new wikilinks, preventing Obsidian's 'File name cannot contain' error popup.
